The '''Old Corellian Run''' was a portion of the original route of the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]. The route split from the modern Run at [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]] and traveled via the [[Pii system/Legends|Pii system]] and [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] until it rejoined the route at [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. Shifting trade routes meant that the modern Corellian Run followed a faster route via [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] and [[Arkanis/Legends|Arkanis]].<ref name="TEA" />
